description: The chart illustrates CoLeG-R (%) scores for three LLaMA-2 model sizes under four sequential supervised fine-tuning (SFT) conditions. The horizontal axis lists the categorical model variants (LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, LLaMA-2-70B) in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “CoLeG-R (%)” on a linear scale with tick marks at regular 10-point intervals from 0 up to 80 (with bars extending slightly above 80). For each model category, four adjacent bars are shown and identified by the legend: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal hatch) is approximately 66 for 7B, 70 for 13B, and 81 for 70B; “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange with horizontal hatch) is approximately 66 for 7B, 74 for 13B, and 82 for 70B; “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal hatch) is approximately 81 for 7B, 85 for 13B, and 85 for 70B; and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (peach solid) is approximately 84 for 7B, 80 for 13B, and 84 for 70B. The bars are grouped by model size with consistent color/hatch encoding across groups, there is no indication that categories are sorted by value, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the legend styling.
caption_used: The bar chart presents CoLeG-R (%) performance metrics for the LLaMA-2 model family under sequential supervised fine-tuning (SFT) conditions. The horizontal axis categorizes three model scales: LLAMA-2-7B, LLAMA-2-13B, and LLAMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis quantifies CoLeG-R (%) from 0 to 80 in 10% increments. Each model category features four bars representing distinct SFT conditions: no SFT (blue, diagonal stripes), SFT on D₀ (yellow, horizontal stripes), SFT on D₀ and D₁ (purple, slanted stripes), and SFT on D₀, D₁, and D₂ (peach, solid fill). For LLAMA-2-7B, performance stabilizes at approximately 66% without SFT, then sharply escalates to 85% with SFT on D₀ and D₁, before slightly declining to 82% with full SFT. The LLAMA-2-13B model demonstrates a more gradual improvement, starting at 70% without SFT, rising modestly to 72% with SFT on D₀, and consistently exceeding 80% with additional SFT datasets, though it fails to surpass the 7B variant under equivalent conditions. The LLAMA-2-70B model exhibits superior baseline performance at 80%, with incremental gains peaking at 83% after SFT on D₀ and D₁, but unexpectedly underperforms relative to the 13B model when fully fine-tuned. These results suggest that while scaling model size broadly enhances CoLeG-R, the benefits of extensive SFT diminish for larger models, particularly when comparing the 13B and 70B variants.
